seoTitle: FAQ — Property Management in Crete | Sivan Management
seoDescription: Answers to common questions about property management fees, reporting, maintenance, short-term rental rules and managing property in Greece from abroad.
title: Questions owners ask us.
lead: Can't find your answer? Send us a message and we will reply personally.

items.a: Request a property assessment through the form. We arrange a call, visit the property and send you a written proposal with scope and fees.
The initial call and property assessment are without obligation. You only pay once you have agreed a written proposal.

items.q: Do I have to sign a long contract?
items.a: Agreements are typically annual with a reasonable notice period. Terms are discussed and agreed with you in advance.
Typically proof of ownership, the property's registration details, existing certificates and any current leases or rental registrations. We give you a checklist.
A percentage of rental income, a fixed monthly fee, per-service pricing, or a combination, depending on the property and scope. Everything is set out in writing.

items.q: How do I receive my income?
items.a: Income is paid to your bank account according to the schedule in your agreement, together with an itemised statement.
Routine costs within an agreed limit are handled directly. Anything above that limit is sent to you for approval with a quote.
No. Rental income depends on the market. We provide realistic estimates and work to optimise results, but we never promise guaranteed income or occupancy.

items.q: How will I know what is happening at my property?
items.a: Through our online owner portal, periodic statements and direct contact with your property manager.

items.q: In which languages can we communicate?
items.a: English and Hebrew, with Greek and other languages supported through our team and partners.
Bookings or rent received, itemised expenses, maintenance carried out, issues and recommendations.
Guests and tenants have a contact number. Urgent issues are handled immediately by our team and trusted professionals, and you are informed.
Our team handles routine tasks. Specialist work is carried out by licensed professionals we coordinate and supervise.

items.q: Do you look after the property in winter?
items.a: Yes. We offer winter checks, storm inspections and seasonal opening and closing.

items.q: Does a short-term rental in Greece need registration?
items.a: Yes. Short-term rental properties must be registered and display a registration number (AMA), and specific tax and reporting rules apply. We guide you and coordinate with your accountant.

items.q: Do you provide legal or tax advice?
items.a: No. We coordinate with qualified lawyers, accountants and engineers. Our role is operational management.
We recommend appropriate property and liability insurance and can coordinate with your insurer. The policy remains in the owner's name.
